strategy_change.previous_gap: repeated coverage of established corridors and event reporting
query_rotation: Patna food hub traditional street food municipal 2026
Patna street food corridor operational status 2026
Patna food current listings emerging vendors 2026
Bihar traditional food event Patna September 2026
Patna food discovery street food creator app India 2026

findings.claim: PMC has proposed dedicated food hubs at JP Ganga Path near Digha Golambar, Khatal Gali in Kotwali and the common service centre premises in Mithapur.
findings.product_implication: Food hubs need lifecycle states: proposed, approved, construction, operational, changed, closed.

findings.claim: The Digha Ganga Path vending concept changed from an earlier small-stall model toward a proposal for about 85 branded food cafes near Digha roundabout.
findings.product_implication: Do not merge multiple plans into one permanent corridor record; preserve plan versions and dates.

findings.claim: Bihar Saras Mela 2026 at Gyan Bhawan runs September 20-29 with 135+ stalls and traditional foods; reporting on September 23 put first-three-day business above Rs 68.56 lakh.
findings.product_implication: Event pages should expose dated food activity and commercial observations separately from static event metadata.

findings.claim: A current Exhibition Road guide uses strong superlatives such as 'densest' and 'purest food experience' without transparent methodology.
findings.product_implication: Editorial superlatives should not increase corridor confidence unless independently corroborated.

findings.claim: Streatzo positions street-food discovery around maps, vendors, pop-ups, home chefs, creator stories and engagement rather than delivery.
findings.product_implication: Crave Hunt can differentiate through source-backed local history, evidence timelines and research transparency rather than competing on generic map coverage.

dedupe_actions: No new canonical entity was created for existing Saras Mela or Digha corridor records; new material is stored as observations/plans.
Pappu Chaiwalla and Street Foods by Punjab Grill remain existing research leads rather than duplicate venue entities.
contradictions: Digha food infrastructure has multiple reported design phases; these are retained as dated plans rather than collapsed into one current fact.
next_build: Implement plan_version and lifecycle_observation support in corridor and vending_zone records, then surface a dated evidence timeline on locality pages.
